    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BuiltinRegistries
    A collection of all accessible registries
    CustomBlockManager
    Represents a way to manage all CustomBlocks currently placed and loaded
    CustomBlockType
    Represents a BlockType which holds information about the hardness and placing material of said block
    CustomTool
    Represents an instance of a CustomTool, holding information about its current state, such as durability and unbreakable status.
    CustomToolType
    Represents a ToolType which holds information about how a tool of this type should behave when turned into an actual item.
    CustomToolType.Builder
    Represents a builder used to create new ToolTypes
    CustomToolType.EventHook<T>
    Represents specific hooks which can be used to attach a callback action for this tool to a given event.
    CustomToolType.MiningLevel
    Represents the vanilla mining levels of the respective tool material
    CustomToolType.MiningSpeed
    Represents the vanilla mining speeds of the respective tool material
    InternalProvider
    Provides necessary data from the plugin to the API.
    MoonBreakApi
    Central entrypoint for the MoonBreak API to work.
    Registrable
    Represents a registrable class (see ResourceRegistry)
    ResourceRegistry<T>
    Represents a registry used for registering resources like CustomBlockType and CustomToolType
